title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Paghaluban, Municipality of Barcelona, Province of Sorsogon, to Peña Francia
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Paghaluban, Municipality of Barcelona, Province of Sorsogon, to Peña Francia
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Paghaluban, Thị trấn Barcelona, Tỉnh Sorsogon thành Peña Francia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Paghaluban, เทศบาล Barcelona, จังหวัด Sorsogon เป็น Peña Francia
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Paghaluban, Kotamadya Barcelona, Provinsi Sorsogon menjadi Peña Francia
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Paghaluban, Perbandaran Barcelona, Wilayah Sorsogon menjadi Peña Francia

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1664_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the barrio of Paghaluban, Municipality of Barcelona, Province of Sorsogon, is changed to Peña Francia.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
